create.title: Create an organization
create.pageDescription: Organizations hold your projects, files and team. Create one to get started.
create.dialogDescription: You will be its owner. You can invite your team right after.

validation.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes, up to 64 characters.

overview.title: Welcome to {{name}}
overview.description: Your dashboard will show projects, members and storage here.

placeholder.description: This section is not available yet.

members.title: Members
members.seats: {{used}} of {{limit}} seats used, pending invitations included
members.removeConfirmDescription: {{name}} will lose access to this organization.
members.leaveConfirmDescription: You will lose access to this organization until someone invites you again.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.revokeConfirmDescription: The invitation link sent to {{email}} will stop working.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.description: We will email an invitation link. You can also copy the link and send it yourself.
invite.createdDescription: We sent the link to {{email}}. Copy it now if you want to share it yourself; it is shown only once.
invite.linkHint: The link works for 7 days and only for the invited email address.
invite.limitReached: Your plan allows {{limit}} members, pending invitations included. Remove a member, revoke an invitation or upgrade the plan.

general.title: General
general.description: The name your team sees and the address used in links.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.description: The new owner gets full control, including billing and deleting the organization. You become an admin.
transfer.noCandidates: Invite someone first; ownership can only go to an existing member.
transfer.confirmDescription: You will become an admin and will not be able to undo this yourself.

delete.title: Delete organization
delete.description: Deletes the organization with its members, invitations and data. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmDescription: All projects, files, members and invitations of this organization are deleted permanently.

acceptInvite.title: Join {{organization}}
acceptInvite.description: You are invited to join {{organization}} as {{role}}.
acceptInvite.signInPrompt: Log in or create an account with {{email}} to accept.
acceptInvite.emailMismatch: This invitation is for {{invitedEmail}}, but you are logged in as {{currentEmail}}.
acceptInvite.invalidDescription: The link is invalid, was revoked or has already been used. Ask for a new invitation.
acceptInvite.expiredDescription: Invitations are valid for 7 days. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Shown in the sidebar and organization switcher.
